svg.title: Spine-leaf VXLAN network topology

desc.style: fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:anthropic-sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

svg.desc: Two spine switches (SPINE11, SPINE12) connected to two leaf switches (LEAF11, LEAF12) in a full mesh. LEAF11 and LEAF12 share a VXLAN tunnel carrying VNI 10110 (L2 Vlan110), VNI 10999 (L3 Vrf_Type5), and VNI 10130 (L2 Vlan130). Four clients connect below the leaves.
